title: What Happens When 100 Geniuses Are Trapped in the Stone Age?
description:
What happens to the 100 greatest scientists in history if they wake up in the Stone Age? We follow Franklin, Newton, Einstein, Curie, Darwin, Snow, Nansen, Wallace and Tesla for a day, a week, a month, a year, ten years and a hundred years, then check the story against the real record: would knowledge alone have beaten history?

The people are real; what they say and do here is our invention. The science, dates and numbers are real and sourced (claim map in the project).
